svg.title: Same demonstrations, different retargeting: success rises with the share of WARP-retargeted data
svg.desc: Line chart with 95% intervals. Closed-loop success in the WARP scene for 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% WARP-retargeted training demos: 0%, 17%, 21%, 29%, 37% (100 rollouts each).

g.text: Each training set holds the same 40 source demonstrations; only how they are retargeted to the robot changes.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: Simulation: DexMimicGen coffee task on a Rainbow RB-Y1. Each point: 2 training seeds × 50 rollouts = 100; bars = Wilson 95% interval.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: The two retargetings place the robot base about 17 cm apart, so the 0% policy never trained in this scene layout.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #98a4b2

g.text: 40 of the 50 evaluation start states come from training demos; on the 10 unseen ones the trend is unclear (20/25/35/25% at 25–100%, n = 20 each).
